caption: The drawing is composed of a square divided into four colored quadrants, alternating between red in the upper right and lower left, and blue in the upper left and lower right. On the upper left quadrant, there is a woven depiction of a yellow sun in the corner, a large white bird with outstretched wings in the upper center, and a small white house with two windows and a door below the bird. The upper right quadrant continues the red background and features trees and foliage in white, extending from the left side. In the lower left quadrant, which has a blue background, there is a white animal that resembles a dog near the bottom edge, small trees, and foliage. The lower right quadrant contains a larger white house with a door, window, and what appears to be a small fence in front, surrounded by trees and plants. Across the center, spanning the boundaries of the quadrants, there is a white figure of a person wearing a hat, holding a plow or similar agricultural tool, with additional white lines suggesting the ground or rows of crops. The entire composition is rendered with a woven or cross-stitched texture in red, blue, white, and yellow threads.
title: Coverlet Detail
